title: Kissed Smoky Tunisian Lamb Tagine
description: A flavorful and aromatic one-pot dish featuring tender lamb, roasted to perfection with a hint of ginger cordial and smoky robata-grill flavors, low in carbs and rich in protein. This dish is perfect for a special occasion or a cozy night in.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, ginger cordial, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Grill the lamb cubes for 5 minutes per side, or until browned.
In a large Dutch oven, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the grilled lamb cubes, chicken broth, and browned bits from the grill to the Dutch oven.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 2 hours.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
